retriever.features: Korean/Latin/digit character bigrams after removing whitespace and punctuation

protocol.answering: Fixed extractive reader: ticket query without organization in query; read only organization markers from top-1 retrieved text; public organization hierarchy allowed, identity-to-organization directory unavailable
protocol.attack: Closed-world candidate filtering from released text only; names and organization markers, optionally role/project; deterministic random tie order fixed by seed. Report realized top-1 and expected uniform-tie success, including empty/wrong candidate sets as failures.
protocol.directory_stress: Cross-team and same-team homonyms; missing entry every 17th identity; stale team every 19th; multiple teams every 23rd, with priority homonym > missing > stale > multi > current
protocol.uncertainty: Three prespecified synthetic worlds: mean and min/max; these are not population confidence intervals
protocol.scope: Entirely fictional Korean documents and directories; names only gold PII. No claim about production NPU embeddings, LLM QA, real employees, or formal anonymity. No trained attacker or policy tuning.
